slice: PAR-71 / 7O.3 anonymous picture-block scale and rotation

authority.observedContract: The anonymous picture-block insertion scale is encoded as BD fields 41/42/43 and insertion rotation as BD54. These are separate from the dimension clone offset, text rotation, line-spacing factor and measurement.

redControl.format: generated low-level common DIMENSION DWG body and generated AC1015 DWG
cases: line-spacing factor, measurement, clone point, and a following LINE remain distinct and correctly ordered
redControl.expectedFailureBeforeFix: The common writer emitted unit scale and zero insertion rotation irrespective of the DRW_Dimension values; the common parser discarded both fields.

behavior: Add explicitly DWG-specific anonymous-block scale/rotation state with identity defaults and public accessors.
Preserve the values through DRW_Dimension copy construction and assignment; reset them when DWG parse state resets.
Parse and encode the common DWG fields without conflating them with clone translation or DXF 41/42.
Reject non-finite scale/rotation before writing any common DIMENSION body bytes.
The new DRW_Dimension members change class layout; downstream consumers must rebuild, consistent with the planned ABI-breaking 2.0 release boundary.
change.testBehavior: An independently authored raw bit reader checks emitted common-field order for AC1018/AC1021/AC1024; a generated scratch AC1015 drawing checks non-default values, defaults, both applyExtrusion modes, and following-record continuity. Additional tests cover reset/copy/assignment and pre-write rejection of NaN. Scratch DWG output is removed by RAII.

proves: The local DWG model/parser/writer preserve anonymous-block scale and rotation state.
The common writer's raw field order leaves later line-spacing, measurement, clone, and following-record values aligned in the tested versions.
Copy/reset defaults and rejection of non-finite values are covered by focused local tests.
doesNotProve: agreement with an independent DWG producer
a DXF group-code mapping or loss/refusal policy for non-default values
anonymous block geometry association, picture rendering, or native CAD display/edit semantics
complete DIMENSION interoperability or broader DWG support
evidenceBoundary.commitReason: The shared worktree contains broad unrelated modifications across the same source, test, and plan files; staging or committing complete files would mix this slice with user work.
